open_questions: Owner: EV24/EV25/EV21/EV22 move from data/events.json (pool_kept) to chains.json pool_new so they carry a gate; ok?
GIG03 to GIG06 'when' uses any_tier:2 as a placeholder start; owner may prefer plain gig_first_cycle.
Stage-2/3 chain triggers (bazaar_stage:2, :3) assume the Bazaar reaches stage 3 before the win; programmer should confirm.
handoff: Texts are final in story/events.md, screens.md and gigs.md; build passes with --out. Wire from this plan: pool_new rows (pool_events, with visible_when from gate; choices use cash_key/stock keys, follow_id for BE01/02/03), chain steps C1-C3 for four markets (chain_steps), gigs GIG03-06 rows and GIG07 note. EV_PST*/EV_PLT*/EV_FLT* are now ordinary gated pool events (no post-built trigger needed). EV75, EV70-EV96 and EV41/42/44/45/48/51 have no data row yet. story/ru has stale ids for deleted/reworded texts (build lists them as RU ERROR); Haiku retranslation is a separate task. Not edited: story/ru, data, game.

details.notes: Zero new kinds. Every choice option has one effect: price up/down, planet closed, shortage, congestion, cash (signed, balance key), stock (Company storage, balance key). Weather house follows Events.house_of unless 'house' given. 'a small sum' and 'some' map to balance keys the programmer adds in the existing band. Pool rows need min_cycle only if wanted. dead_2/dead_1 worlds count as post_built when reclaimed; platform_built used for mining platform events.
